answer_text:
The even cycle types in \(S_7\) are

\[
1^7,\quad 2^2 1^3,\quad 3 1^4,\quad 3^2 1,\quad 3 2^2,\quad 4 2 1,\quad 5 1^2,\quad 7.
\]

In passing to \(A_7\), an \(S_7\)-conjugacy class of even permutations splits into two \(A_7\)-classes exactly when the cycle type consists of distinct odd parts. Among the types above, only the 7-cycle type \(7\) splits.

Your listed representatives cover

\[
1^7,\; 3 1^4,\; 5 1^2,\; 2^2 1^3,\; 3^2 1,\; 4 2 1.
\]

Accounting for the two split 7-cycle classes, the only remaining missing class has cycle type

\[
3+2+2.
\]

A representative is

\[
\boxed{(123)(45)(67)}.
\]
